episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Seo Hwi receives orders from Lee Bang Won to carry out an attack -- and finds himself face-to-face with Nam Sun Ho. Han Hee Jae tries to evade capture.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: As a child, Hee Jae comes across Seo Gum after witnessing a traumatic event. Hwi, Seo Yun, and Hee Jae get separated from Sun Ho while kite flying.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: There are those who resolve to forget -- and those who don't Hee Jae confronts Sun Ho about what happened. Park Chi Do finds Hwi on the battlefield.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: While on the run, Hwi hears a difficult truth from Sun Ho. Hee Jae travels with Yi Bang Won as he escorts Queen Shinduk and her sons to safety.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Hwi stays away from Hee Jae, who holds on to hope that he is still alive, and keeps an eye on Seo Yun. A high-ranking nobleman is kidnapped.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Sun Ho requests power from Lee Sung Kye. Ihwaru covers up a murder. Hwi and his friends hatch a plan involving Bang Won.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Wary of Hwi's intentions, Bang Won tries to figure out what he's after. Sung Gye's council calls for Sun Ho's punishment.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Hee Jae comes across a man who haunts her memories. Sung Gye issues a warning to Nam Jun, and declares the heir to his throne.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Jun's true objectives -- as well as Hwi's -- are made clear to Bang Won. Fearing for Yun's safety, Sun Ho takes her and runs.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Devastated by a sudden loss, Hwi takes his rage to Jun. Six years later, Sun Ho hunts down a thief who's been interception precious cargo.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Hwi, seeking revenge, conspires with Bang Won. Sun Ho advises Sung Gye on what must be done in order to protect his crown.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Bang Won's rebellion strikes, and Sung Gye realizes it too late. Hwi has just one target -- but Sun Ho stands in his way.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: With no further reason to stay by Bang Won's side, Hwi walks away -- but finds he must contend with Sung Gye's revenge.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: Sun Ho acquires soldiers. Hee Jae mourns all that Ihwaru has lost. Hwi and Bang Won fool Lee Bang Gan into feeling a false sense of security.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: Bloody conflict erupts as Bang Gan attacks Bang Won. Hwi looks out for Sun Ho, who returns the favor after uncovering an unfortunate history.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: Ahead of the ceremony, Bang Won and Sung Gye each send men after Hwi and Sun Ho, who know what must be done to keep everyone safe.
